steps.title: Application submitted
steps.markdownContent:
Your application for an NHC {applicationType} has been submitted.

We have sent your reference number to the email address you gave us. Keep this number in case you need to contact the National Housing Corporation about your application.

## What happens next

NHC will send you an email within 1 to 2 working days to confirm they have received your application.

NHC will check your application. A housing officer may contact you if they need more information.

{rentalWaitingList}

## Contact

National Housing Corporation  
“The Garden”  
Country Road  
St. Michael

Telephone: (246) 536-5300  
Email: NHC.CustomerService@barbados.gov.bb
